title: DTCC tokenisation service goes live
snippet: The Depository Trust Company (DTC), a subsidiary of The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry, today launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS).

title: Ripple Brings Its Stablecoin to Coinbase’s Trading Platforms
message_html: Ripple Brings Its Stablecoin to Coinbase’s Trading Platforms ...
snippet: Ripple has begun listing its RLUSD stablecoin on Coinbase’s institutional and retail platforms. Clients can now trade and manage RLUSD through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange, and the Coinbase Retail application, Ripple announced Wednesday (Oct. 28), with availability on Coinbase Global Exchange,
